title: Rampaging Monolith
summary: Break the Rampaging Monolith into progressively smaller pieces while controlling its fragments.
overview: Break the Rampaging Monolith into progressively smaller pieces while controlling its fragments.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Assign an add tank and clear fragments before pushing the next health threshold.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: At 85%, 70%, 55%, 40%, 25% and 10% health, the boss releases four debris and rubble adds.
Each threshold also shrinks the boss, but does not remove the existing fragments.
Pause boss damage when necessary to prevent several fragment waves overlapping.
